style_authority.note: Preserves the calm utility posture and limits motion to direct manipulation, causal settling, and restrained pointer or state feedback.

reference_selection.note: Applies the relevant gesture, interaction-physics, motion, accessibility, and validation guidance without loading unrelated design material.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Rejects transition-all, layout-property animation, whole-sheet scaling, decorative bounce, and the assumption that additional motion is inherently better.

evidence_level.note: Labels the review L0 static and makes no browser, pointer-trace, frame-timeline, responsive, Reduced Motion, or device-validation claim.

verified_boundary.note: Separates code-visible risks from unverified runtime jank, cascade behavior, touch feel, responsive coordinates, hidden compensating code, and product semantics.

design_moves.note: Provides eight implementable moves covering feedback, pointer capture, grab offset, transform ownership, interruption, velocity and projection, soft bounds, and Reduced Motion.

scope_control.note: Stays read-only and motion-specific, fits within 96 lines, and prioritizes exactly five blockers and eight concrete moves.
